pages.text:
Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens | Luxury Resort Ubud Bali
Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens
A Luxury Jungle Resort in Payangan, Greater Ubud, Bali
Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens is a luxury jungle resort in Banjar Susut, Desa Buahan, Payangan, within the greater Ubud area of Bali. Set on a tropical hillside overlooking the Ayung River valley, Nandini brings together private jungle villas and Royal Suites, spa and riverside wellness experiences, dining, and curated cultural and nature-led activities
Designed for couples, honeymooners, wellness travelers, families and guests seeking a quieter side of Bali, the resort combines warm Balinese hospitality with an immersive rainforest setting.
Private Jungle Villas & Royal Suites
Stay in private jungle villas in Ubud and spacious royal suites surrounded by rainforest, tropical greenery, and the calm atmosphere of Bali. Each accommodation at Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens is designed for comfort, privacy, and warm Balinese character, creating a refined jungle retreat for couples, families, and guests seeking space to reconnect with nature.
Jungle View Villa
The Jungle View Villa offers forest views, generous outdoor living, and Balinese village-inspired details. This private villa in Ubud invites you to slow down, enjoy the resort's tropical setting, and stay close to the natural beauty of Bali.
More Details
Reserve
Sunrise View Villa
The Sunrise View Villa welcomes golden morning light and tranquil rainforest ambience into your stay. Created for quiet mornings and relaxed moments, this villa offers a serene jungle experience in Bali where nature, comfort, and understated luxury come together.
More Details
Reserve
Panoramic Jungle View Villa
The Panoramic Jungle View Villa offers sweeping river valley views, 48 square metres of accommodation, a canopied king-size bed and a private balcony overlooking the rainforest. Balinese-inspired architecture and teak flooring create a quiet retreat close to nature.
More Details
Reserve
Private Garden Royal Suite
The Private Garden Royal Suite offers refined comfort, generous space, and a private terrace overlooking lush tropical gardens. Designed for quiet relaxation, this royal suite in Ubud creates a restful stay with privacy and natural charm.
More Details
Reserve
Jungle View Royal Suite
The Jungle View Royal Suite blends refined comfort with the natural beauty of the surrounding rainforest. This spacious luxury suite in Ubud offers elegant interiors, peaceful views, and extra room for guests who want more space during their Bali escape.
More Details
Reserve
Panoramic Corner Jacuzzi Royal Suite
The Panoramic Corner Jacuzzi Royal Suite is a spacious 120-square-meter sanctuary with panoramic views of the lush jungle in Ubud, Bali. With generous space, refined comfort, and a private Jacuzzi setting, this suite is ideal for guests seeking a luxury jungle suite surrounded by nature.
More Details
Reserve
Presidential Royal Suite
One of the largest suites in Bali, the Presidential Royal Suite offers exceptional space, privacy, and refined comfort within the natural setting of Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens. With elegant furnishings, a generous living area, a master bedroom, and a private terrace overlooking lush gardens, this suite is ideal for families or guests seeking an elevated Bali jungle resort stay.
More Details
Experiences Beyond the Stay
Enhance your stay at Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens with curated experiences in the heart of Bali's rainforest. From romantic dining and jungle celebrations to floating breakfast and calming spa rituals, each experience is designed to enrich your Ubud retreat with nature, romance, and authentic Balinese hospitality.
Jungle Romance
Celebrate intimate moments with a candlelit setting surrounded by tropical greenery and the soft atmosphere of Bali's jungle. Created for couples, this romantic jungle experience is designed for proposals, anniversaries, honeymoons, and meaningful celebrations in nature.
Explore More
Signature Dining Experiences
Enjoy memorable dining moments surrounded by tropical scenery, refined flavors, and warm Balinese hospitality. Each dining experience at Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens is created to make your stay feel personal, memorable, and connected to the beauty of Ubud.
Explore More
Jungle Wellness & Spa Rituals
Restore balance with calming spa and wellness rituals inspired by Bali's rainforest. Designed to relax the body, refresh the mind, and reconnect you with nature, each treatment brings a deeper sense of peace to your jungle retreat.
Explore More
Ubud Jungle Adventures
Discover Bali’s natural beauty through outdoor adventures, cultural encounters, and scenic jungle experiences designed to enrich your stay at Nandini.
Explore More
Curated Experience Packages
Explore thoughtfully curated experiences that bring together Nandini’s most memorable activities, from romance and wellness to adventure and authentic Balinese moments.

Curated Escapes at Nandini Jungle
Discover exclusive offers at Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens, created for guests who want more than a short getaway. From extended stays to twin-island escapes, each package combines nature, comfort, and meaningful experiences for a memorable Bali jungle resort stay.
Black Friday Limited-Time Offer
Enjoy a resort credit or a relaxing massage for two during our Black Friday campaign. This special offer is available for bookings made within this month only, so don’t miss the chance to elevate your jungle escape with added benefits and unforgettable experiences.

pages.text:
About Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens | Ubud Bali Resort
Our Story
Rooted in the Jungle Since 2005
What began as an intimate hillside retreat has evolved over two decades into Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens — while remaining deeply connected to the landscape, community and traditions that shaped its beginning.
Susut, Payangan · Bali
Discover Our Story
Where It Began
A Chance Encounter That Became Nandini
In the late 1990s and early 2000s, Swedish entrepreneur Magnus Falk frequently travelled through the Ubud region. While exploring the area by bicycle, a chance meeting with a local villager led him to the hillside that would eventually become Nandini.
The steep terrain was challenging, but instead of removing the character of the landscape, the resort was built into it — allowing villas, pathways and tropical vegetation to follow the natural contours of the hillside.
“I like to think that the land came to me rather than the other way around.”
— Magnus Falk
Two Decades of Nandini
A Story in Time
Late 1990s
The Beginning
A chance encounter during Magnus Falk’s travels through the Ubud region leads to the land that would become Nandini.
2005
Nandini Opens
Nandini opens as an intimate hillside retreat.
2007
The River
Access through the jungle is created to reach the secluded riverside below the resort.
2019
A New Chapter
Nandini thoughtfully expands while preserving the character of the original hillside retreat.
2022
Renewing Nandini
Major renovation and upgrades refresh villas and resort facilities.
2024
New & Upgraded
Royal Suites and new dining and wellness experiences mark another evolution.
Today
The Story Continues
Nandini continues to evolve in harmony with the jungle.
2005
The Beginning
The Beginning. One Remarkable Hillside.
Nandini officially opened in 2005 as an intimate retreat built along the steep jungle hillside. Inspired by traditional Balinese architecture, the original villas were created to sit naturally within their surroundings.
2007
A Hidden World Below
The Journey Down to the River
When Nandini first opened, the river far below the resort was not yet part of the guest experience. Access was created in 2007 through a series of steep steps descending through the jungle, with a lift later assisting guests for part of the journey.
Explore Nandini Experiences
Then & Now
The Evolution of Nandini
The resort has changed considerably since opening in 2005, but the landscape that shaped Nandini remains at the heart of its identity.
Then
The Early Years
Nandini began as an intimate collection of hillside villas, shaped by the jungle and rooted in Balinese character.
Now
2019
A New Chapter
Growing Without Losing the Landscape
The 2019 expansion marked one of the most significant chapters in Nandini’s history, introducing new accommodation while retaining the jungle setting and character of the original hillside retreat.
2022
A Major Renewal
Renewing the Nandini Experience
A major renovation and upgrade refreshed the original villas and expanded spaces throughout the resort, including enhancements to the lounge together with additions such as the pool bar, riverside yoga area, gym and wedding chapel.
Jungle Villa
Pool Bar
Djiwa Shala
Heritage Lounge
Funicular
2024
The Next Chapter
New & Upgraded Nandini
Nandini introduced another significant evolution of the resort experience, with upgraded accommodation and expanded dining and wellness concepts alongside the original Jungle Villas.
Royal Suites
Jungle Living
Wine Cellar
A New Dining Chapter
Wine Spa
Wellness Reimagined
Fitness Centre
Wellness in Motion
Beyond the Years
What Has Never Changed
Nandini has evolved, but the principles behind it remain closely connected to its surroundings.
01
The Land
Respecting the jungle landscape and allowing architecture to follow the natural hillside.
02
The Community
Working with local team members and communities whose knowledge and traditions remain part of the Nandini experience.
03
Balinese Character
Natural materials, craftsmanship and Balinese traditions continue to influence the way Nandini looks, feels and welcomes its guests.
Nandini Today
The Story Continues
From the original hillside villas to contemporary Royal Suites, riverside wellness, dining and immersive jungle experiences, today’s Nandini continues the story that began more than two decades ago.

Be Part of Our Continuing Story
More than two decades after opening its doors, Nandini continues to evolve — shaped by the jungle, its people and every guest who becomes part of its story.
